criteria.text: Identifies that the Foxley Engineering Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 10 September 2027 (18 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 10 March 2029 (36 months after Closing).
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.2 is stated as $21,600,000 but 12% of the $200,000,000 Purchase Price is $24,000,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.
Flags that the disclosure letter is inconsistent with the material contract on change of control.
Lists the Foxley Engineering Ltd change-of-control consent as a required third-party consent and states it has not been obtained.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
